provenance.formula_note: the ISO 286-1 i-formula is not a gate: the published IT series is rounded to preferred numbers (16i = 24.03 um for >30-50 mm is published as IT7 = 25 um), so it cannot validate these tables
provenance.rule: a cell is published here only when the PDF table and the HTML table state the same upper and lower deviation for the same class over the same nominal size step, when that step is one ISO 286-2 defines, and when the cell's band width equals the IT value Table 1 prints for that step and grade
